posts.alt: Stacks of shipping containers at a port with a container truck in front.
posts.fb:
FOB, CFR or CIF: which price should you ask for? 🚢

• FOB (Free on Board): price up to loading on the ship in India. You arrange freight and insurance.
• CFR (Cost & Freight): we also pay sea freight to your port. You arrange insurance.
• CIF (Cost, Insurance & Freight): freight and insurance to your port are included.

New to importing? CIF is simplest. Have your own freight forwarder? FOB often works out cheaper.

We quote on any of these terms: sunitaexports.com/contact

posts.fb:
20 ft or 40 ft container? It depends on what you ship 📦

⚖️ Heavy goods (rice, pulses, flours, sugar): the container hits its weight limit before it is full, so a 20 ft is usually the best value.

🎈 Light, bulky goods (dehydrated onion flakes, whole chillies, herbs, snacks): space runs out first, so a 40 ft carries much more for a similar freight cost.

🧩 Mixed loads: we plan the mix so you use both weight and space well.

Tell us your product list and we'll suggest the right container: sunitaexports.com/mixed-container
